unmeasured.wrf_exe_sha256: the reference binary lives on the campaign compute nodes, not in this repository; its bytes must be hashed there and the digest committed here. Nothing in this tree can measure it, and a digest nobody read is not a receipt.
unmeasured.build_recipe_sha256: the build recipe is committed beside this manifest once the recipe that produced the reference binary is transcribed from the node it was built on; the digest is then the SHA-256 of that committed file.
unmeasured.namelist_sha256: namelist.wps and namelist.input for the reference run are recorded with the run metadata on the compute node and are not in this repository yet.
unmeasured.reference_wrfout_sha256: the reference wrfout stream is not redistributable and is not in this repository; only its per-frame digests belong here, and they must be taken from the frames the comparison actually scored.
